# Test fixtures

The cloud sandbox that wrote Phase 1 could not reach `api.apify.com` or `apify.com`, so most Apify responses here were written offline. **None of the Store data is real.** Actor names, usernames and numbers are invented. Only the shapes follow Apify's published OpenAPI specification ([apify/apify-docs](https://github.com/apify/apify-docs), `apify-api/openapi`).

| File | What it is | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `apify/openapi_store_example.json` | One `GET /v2/store` response | Copied from the documented example in Apify's OpenAPI spec (`ListOfStoreActorsResponse`) |
| `apify/openapi_actor_example.json` | One `GET /v2/acts/{actorId}` response | Copied from the documented example in Apify's OpenAPI spec (Get Actor) |
| `apify/store_actors.json` | 84 Store items (`StoreActor` shape) | Synthetic, generated by `build_fixtures.py` |
| `apify/actor_details.json` | Actor detail responses keyed by Actor id; one is missing on purpose | Synthetic, generated by `build_fixtures.py` |
| `apify/ideas_export.json` | The Ideas export (`/api/ideas/download?format=json&status=toDevelop`) | Synthetic, generated by `build_fixtures.py`, in the real export's shape |
| `apify/idea_pages.json` | Idea page HTML keyed by URL, reduced to the upvote element; one page is missing on purpose | Synthetic, generated by `build_fixtures.py` |
| `apify/ideas_export_real_sample.json` | The first 3 entries of the real export | Real, captured 2026-10-24 |
| `apify/idea_page_real_snippet.html` | The upvote button from a real idea page | Real, captured 2026-10-24 |
| `robots/` | robots.txt per target host: `<host>.txt` is served as 200, `<host>.404` as a 404 | Synthetic |
| `validator/assessments.json` | One model assessment per sample candidate | Hand-written to the Validator's JSON schema, **not model output**; marked `"model": "hand-written-sample"` |
| `manifest.json` | The "now" the samples are dated against | |

`FixtureSource` (in `factory/scout/sources.py`) serves `store_actors.json` the way the API does: it filters by category, sorts by popularity and pages with offset and limit.

## Replacing them with real data

Each Scout run in GitHub Actions uploads a `scout-output` artifact. Its `raw/` folder holds the untouched responses:

- `raw/store/<category>_<offset>.json`: Store pages. Merge their `data.items` into `apify/store_actors.json`.
- `raw/acts/<actorId>.json`: Actor details. Key them by id in `apify/actor_details.json`.
- `raw/ideas_export.json`: the real Ideas export, in the same shape as `apify/ideas_export.json`. Upvotes are not saved raw; they appear per idea in `scout.json`.

Replacing the Store fixtures changes which 20 niches are selected, so `validator/assessments.json`, `robots/` and the expected values in the tests must be updated together. Before committing a real capture, remove any personal data, such as developers' full names (`userFullName`) and profile picture URLs.
